runs.text: Figure 4. Three-layer synthetic aviation-fuel supply-chain architecture. Source: Nexus系统提交文件_正文同步20261009/Manuscript_Clean.docx, Figure 4 caption and Methods; Supplementary Sections 3.5–3.11. Production and inventory use 3-hour periods. Hydrogen dispatch is balanced within those periods with common weekly route contracts. GTL-GH natural-gas allocation is daily. Airport fuel deliveries and demand are weekly. Carbon sources and hydrogen sources enter the selected conversion configuration; only SAF product enters the airport fuel inlet. The illustrated modules are alternatives and need not be simultaneously active. Buffer capacities are scenario-specific, with zero H₂ inventory in the six re-evaluated configurations.
